description.value: Mama's Dumpling & Coffee is a Chinese restaurant in Richmond specializing in handmade Shanghai-style dumplings, with the Nanxiang-style Xiao Long Bao (soup dumplings) as its signature dish. The menu spans dim sum, wontons, noodles, cold appetizers, and large plates, covering a wide range of Northern and Shanghai-style Chinese cooking. Frozen dumplings are available to take home at a discount, and the restaurant also offers catering.
